prompt: Preciso de um diagrama de sequência do fluxo de checkout do nosso e-commerce pra colocar no README. Pode fazer?

assertions.text: Asks the user clarifying questions about the checkout flow (participants, trigger, sync vs async, failure handling, or level of technical detail) instead of only delivering a finished diagram
No fabricated technical specifics (endpoint paths, header names, payload fields, status codes) are presented as facts about the user's actual system
Any mermaid code included parses successfully (valid sequenceDiagram syntax)
